transforms.name: past
transforms.description: Past tense of the irregular verbs: chonaic, chuaigh, rinne, dúirt, fuair, tháinig, thug, rug, chuala, bhí, with the dependent forms faca, deachaigh, dearna, raibh. Regular verbs lenite the stem (bhris, cheannaigh, shiúil) or put d' before a vowel or fh (d'ól, d'éirigh, d'fhág), which lenition and the elided particle remove.

transforms.name: lenition
transforms.description: Lenition (séimhiú): h after the first consonant, after mo, do, a (his), ní, má, the article (an bhean), in compounds and on adjectives after a feminine noun: bhean → bean, chat → cat, shráid → sráid, Shasana → Sasana.

transforms.name: eclipsis
transforms.description: Eclipsis (urú): a consonant before the first one, or n- before a vowel, after ár, bhur, a (their), i, go, an (interrogative), nach, dá and the article after prepositions: mbád → bád, gcathair → cathair, bhfuil → fuil, ndoras → doras, n-athair → athair, i nÉirinn → Éirinn, i mBaile Átha Cliath → Baile Átha Cliath.

transforms.name: h before a vowel
transforms.description: h before a vowel after na (na hoíche), a (her: a hathair), le, go, chomh, ní (copula) and the ordinals: hoíche → oíche, hÉireann → Éireann, hathair → athair.

transforms.name: t before a vowel or s
transforms.description: t- before a vowel of a masculine noun after the article (an t-uisce, an tUachtarán, an tAire) and t before s after an (an tsráid, an tsúil): t-uisce → uisce, tUachtarán → Uachtarán, tAire → aire, tsráid → sráid.

transforms.name: elided particle
transforms.description: d', m' and b' before a vowel or fh: do (your), mo (my), the past particle do and the copula ba: d'athair → athair, m'fhear → fear, d'ólfadh → ólfadh, b'fhéidir → féidir.

transforms.name: emphatic
transforms.description: Emphatic suffixes -sa, -se, -san, -sean and -ne on prepositional pronouns and verbs, and the emphatic pronouns: agamsa → agam, againne → againn, aigesean → aige, molaimse → molaim, mholfainnse → mholfainn, mise → mé, eisean → é.

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Strong plurals: -(e)anna (scoileanna, amanna), -í (cailíní, múinteoirí, páistí), -aí (daltaí, rudaí), -(e)acha (teangacha, cathracha, litreacha), -te and -the (bailte, coillte, ríthe), -ta (scéalta), -anta (oícheanta, uaireanta), -nna (míonna), -ite (sluaite), -uithe (athruithe), -taí and -tí of verbal nouns (moltaí, cinntí), and the irregular plurals (mná, daoine, tithe, laethanta, cairde, ba).

transforms.name: comparative / plural / genitive feminine
transforms.description: An adjective in -e or -úla: the comparative and superlative (níos óige, is glaine), the genitive singular feminine (na mná óige) and, for slender stems, the plural (glice, maithe): óige → óg, glaine → glan, gile → geal, mine → mion, deise → deas, tábhachtaí → tábhachtach, dírí → díreach, suimiúla → suimiúil, láidre → láidir, deacra → deacair, milse → milis.

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Plural of an adjective: móra, beaga, deasa, tábhachtacha, díreacha; with syncope ramhra, folmha, socra, láidre.

transforms.name: comparative
transforms.description: Irregular comparatives and superlatives (níos mó, is fearr): mó → mór, lú → beag, fearr → maith, measa → olc, sine → sean, faide → fada, giorra → gearr, teo → te, fusa → furasta, túisce → luath, áille → álainn, ísle → íseal, uaisle → uasal.

transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Plural in -aí of a noun ending in a consonant: rudaí → rud.

transforms.name: plural / genitive
transforms.description: The ending -a: plural of many nouns (bróga, cosa, lámha, fuinneoga, úlla, tosca) and the genitive singular of the third declension (ama, srutha, locha, Gaeltachta, sleachta).

transforms.name: genitive / plural / vocative
transforms.description: Slender form of a first-declension noun or adjective: genitive singular (an bháid, an fhir, an Sasanaigh), plural (na báid, na fir, éin), vocative (a Sheáin, a fhir) and the genitive masculine of adjectives (an fhir mhóir): báid → bád, fir → fear, éin → éan, poist → post, Sasanaigh → Sasanach, Eiritréigh → Eiritréach.

transforms.name: genitive
transforms.description: Genitive singular of the second to fifth declensions: -e with a slender stem (sráide, bróige, coise, láimhe, gréine), -aí and -í for -ach and -each (gealaí, báistí), the broad endings of agent nouns (múinteora, dochtúra, búistéara, feola, bliana), -ach, -rach, -ar and -n (cathrach, traenach, athar, teangan, carad, Éireann), and the irregular nouns (tí, lae, mná, Dé, mara, fola).

transforms.name: present 1sg
transforms.description: Present tense, first person singular (also the imperative 1sg): molaim, brisim, ceannaím, éirím, osclaím, buaim, léim, suím.

transforms.name: present
transforms.description: Present tense with a pronoun or noun subject (mol + -ann): molann sé, briseann tú, ceannaíonn siad, éiríonn sí, buann, léann, suíonn.

transforms.name: present 1pl
transforms.description: Present tense, first person plural (also the present subjunctive 1pl): molaimid, brisimid, ceannaímid, éirímid, buaimid, léimid, suímid.

transforms.name: present autonomous
transforms.description: Present autonomous (no subject named; also the imperative and present subjunctive autonomous): moltar, bristear, ceannaítear, éirítear, buaitear, léitear, suitear, caitear.

transforms.name: present 2sg (Munster)
transforms.description: Present tense, second person singular, Munster synthetic form (also the present subjunctive 2sg): molair, brisir, ceannaír.

transforms.name: present 3pl (Munster)
transforms.description: Present tense, third person plural, Munster synthetic form: molaid, brisid, ceannaíd.

transforms.name: past 1sg (Munster) / present relative
transforms.description: Past tense, first person singular, Munster synthetic form (mholas, bhriseas), which is also the Munster relative of the present (a mholas).

transforms.name: past 2sg (Munster)
transforms.description: Past tense, second person singular, Munster synthetic form: mholais, bhrisis, cheannaís.

transforms.name: past 1pl
transforms.description: Past tense, first person plural: mholamar, bhriseamar, cheannaíomar, d'éiríomar, bhuamar, léamar, shuíomar.

transforms.name: past 1pl (Munster)
transforms.description: Past tense, first person plural, Munster synthetic form: mholamair, bhriseamair, cheannaíomair, d'ólamair.

transforms.name: past 2pl (Munster)
transforms.description: Past tense, second person plural, Munster synthetic form: mholabhair, bhriseabhair, cheannaíobhair.

transforms.name: past 3pl (Munster)
transforms.description: Past tense, third person plural, Munster synthetic form: mholadar, bhriseadar, cheannaíodar.

transforms.name: past autonomous / habitual / verbal noun
transforms.description: The ending -(e)adh, -(a)íodh: past autonomous (moladh é, ceannaíodh), past habitual and past subjunctive 3rd singular (mholadh sé, dá gceannaíodh sé), imperative 3rd singular (moladh sé), and the verbal noun of many verbs (ag moladh, ag briseadh).

transforms.name: future
transforms.description: Future tense with a pronoun or noun subject: molfaidh, brisfidh, ceannóidh, éireoidh, osclóidh, buafaidh, léifidh, suífidh; Munster ceannóchaidh.

transforms.name: future 1pl
transforms.description: Future tense, first person plural: molfaimid, brisfimid, ceannóimid, éireoimid, buafaimid, léifimid.

transforms.name: future autonomous
transforms.description: Future autonomous: molfar, brisfear, ceannófar, éireofar, buafar, léifear.

transforms.name: future 1sg (Munster)
transforms.description: Future tense, first person singular, Munster synthetic form: molfad, brisfead, ceannód.

transforms.name: future 2sg (Munster)
transforms.description: Future tense, second person singular, Munster synthetic form: molfair, brisfir, ceannóir.

transforms.name: future 3pl (Munster)
transforms.description: Future tense, third person plural, Munster synthetic form: molfaid, brisfid, ceannóid.

transforms.name: future relative (Munster)
transforms.description: Relative form of the future, Munster: a mholfas, a bhrisfeas, a cheannós.

transforms.name: conditional 1sg
transforms.description: Conditional mood, first person singular: mholfainn, bhrisfinn, cheannóinn, d'éireoinn, bhuafainn, léifinn.

transforms.name: conditional 2sg
transforms.description: Conditional mood, second person singular: mholfá, bhrisfeá, cheannófá, d'éireofá, bhuafá, léifeá.

transforms.name: conditional
transforms.description: Conditional mood with a pronoun or noun subject: mholfadh, bhrisfeadh, cheannódh, d'éireodh, bhuafadh, léifeadh.

transforms.name: conditional 1pl
transforms.description: Conditional mood, first person plural: mholfaimis, bhrisfimis, cheannóimis, d'éireoimis.

transforms.name: conditional 3pl
transforms.description: Conditional mood, third person plural: mholfaidís, bhrisfidís, cheannóidís, d'éireoidís.

transforms.name: conditional autonomous
transforms.description: Conditional autonomous: mholfaí, bhrisfí, cheannófaí, d'éireofaí.

transforms.name: past habitual 1sg
transforms.description: Past habitual, first person singular (also the past subjunctive 1sg): mholainn, bhrisinn, cheannaínn, d'éirínn, bhuainn, léinn.

transforms.name: past habitual 2sg
transforms.description: Past habitual, second person singular (also the past subjunctive 2sg): mholtá, bhristeá, cheannaíteá, bhuaiteá, léiteá, chaiteá.

transforms.name: past habitual / imperative 1pl
transforms.description: First person plural of the past habitual and past subjunctive (mholaimis, dá mbrisimis) and of the imperative (molaimis): ceannaímis, éirímis, buaimis, léimis.

transforms.name: past habitual / imperative 3pl
transforms.description: Third person plural of the past habitual and past subjunctive (mholaidís, dá mbrisidís) and of the imperative (molaidís): ceannaídís, éirídís, buaidís, léidís.

transforms.name: past habitual autonomous
transforms.description: Past habitual autonomous (also the past subjunctive autonomous): mholtaí, bhristí, cheannaítí, bhuaití, léití, chaití.

transforms.name: imperative 2pl
transforms.description: Imperative, second person plural: molaigí, brisigí, ceannaígí, éirígí, osclaígí, buaigí, léigí, suígí.

transforms.name: present subjunctive
transforms.description: Present subjunctive (after go, nár, sula): go mola sé, go mbrise, go gceannaí, go n-éirí, go mbua, go lé, go dté, go suí.

transforms.name: verbal adjective
transforms.description: Verbal adjective (past participle): molta, briste, scríofa, caite, ceannaithe, éirithe, oscailte, labhartha, imeartha, buaite, léite, suite, sábháilte, taispeánta.

transforms.name: verbal noun
transforms.description: Verbal noun (ag + verbal noun is the progressive): fágáil, feiceáil, déanamh, caitheamh, fanacht, éisteacht, féachaint, leanúint, ceartú, míniú, ceannach, oscailt, imirt, labhairt, tarraingt; irregular rá, teacht, dul, fáil, tabhairt, bheith.

transforms.name: prepositional pronoun 1sg
transforms.description: Prepositional pronoun, first person singular: agam, orm, liom, dom, uaim, fúm.

transforms.name: prepositional pronoun 2sg
transforms.description: Prepositional pronoun, second person singular: agat, ort, leat, duit, uait, fút.

transforms.name: prepositional pronoun 3sg m.
transforms.description: Prepositional pronoun, third person singular masculine: aige, air, leis, dó, uaidh, ann.

transforms.name: prepositional pronoun 3sg f.
transforms.description: Prepositional pronoun, third person singular feminine: aici, uirthi, léi, di, uaithi, inti.

transforms.name: prepositional pronoun 1pl
transforms.description: Prepositional pronoun, first person plural: againn, orainn, linn, dúinn, uainn, fúinn.

transforms.name: prepositional pronoun 2pl
transforms.description: Prepositional pronoun, second person plural: agaibh, oraibh, libh, daoibh, uaibh, fúibh.

transforms.name: prepositional pronoun 3pl
transforms.description: Prepositional pronoun, third person plural: acu, orthu, leo, dóibh, uathu, fúthu.

transforms.name: copula
transforms.description: Forms of the copula is: ba (past and conditional), níorbh, arbh, gurbh, nárbh, cérbh (before a vowel or f), ab and gurb (dependent present before a vowel).
